newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Cosipa still a hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Cosipa still a hold.

text.p: Salomon Brothers/Banco Patrimonio on Monday said it had reiterated its hold rating on Brazilian steelmaker Cosipa based on a steady recovery of the firm's operations.
- The company reported net losses of $39 million in the second quarter, against net losses of $96 million in the same period a year ago.

- also said that, at this time, it recommends "the purchase of Usiminas as the best way to play on Cosipa's recovery" because, first, a likely merger between Cosipa and Usiminas operations should translate into additional hot and rolled capacity from Cosipa.

- "Second, Usiminas should have the ability to transform Cosipa's products into higher-value-added products and leverage its own distribution channels to further add value on Cosipa's product lines," analysts Mauricio Reveco, E. Lucia Ramos and R. Angele said in a report.
- Cosipa preferred stock closed off 1.61 percent at 0.61 reais on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
